LOAN AGREEMENT

This Agreement, executed this 12th day of January 2026 at Quezon City, by and between ELENITA R. VILLANUEVA, of legal age, Filipino, with residence at 21 Malumanay St., Teachers Village East, Quezon City (the LENDER), and RICARDO M. CRUZ, of legal age, Filipino, with residence at 8-B Sampaguita Extension, Project 6, Quezon City (the BORROWER).

1. The LENDER agrees to lend the sum of ONE HUNDRED THOUSAND PESOS (PHP 100,000.00), receipt of which is acknowledged by the BORROWER upon transfer.
2. The BORROWER undertakes to repay the principal in full on or before 30 April 2026.
3. Interest of two percent (2%) per month shall accrue on any unpaid balance after due date.

SIGNED in the presence of: Maricar S. Delos Reyes, Benigno T. Alcantara

chronology.text: On 12 January 2026, complainant Elenita R. Villanueva and respondent Ricardo M. Cruz executed a written Loan Agreement in Quezon City, under which Villanueva lent Cruz the sum of PHP 100,000.00 payable on or before 30 April 2026.
On 15 January 2026, Villanueva transferred the full principal through GCash under reference number 8014 5573 9921, addressed to a mobile number ending in 82.
On 1 February 2026, in a Messenger exchange, Cruz acknowledged the obligation, committed to pay the whole amount, and stated that he would issue a check.

On or about 14 February 2026, Cruz issued BDO Check No. 0123456 for PHP 100,000.00 bearing the date 30 April 2026. The check was deposited on 5 March 2026 and returned on 8 March 2026 with the notation DRAWN AGAINST INSUFFICIENT FUNDS.

On 10 March 2026, counsel for Villanueva served a written notice of dishonor and final demand giving five banking days from receipt within which to pay in cash. Courier records indicate delivery on 18 March 2026, although the receiving party cannot be identified from the copy on file.
The period lapsed on 2 April 2026 without payment. No record of any payment appears in the case file to date.

proofMatrix.basis: Elements listed here follow the standard four-element formulation used in BP 22 prosecutions. Confirm against current jurisprudence before filing.

elements.element: Making, drawing and issuance of a check to apply on account or for value
elements.note: The check photograph is readable except for the amount in words. The original is still with the client.

elements.element: Knowledge by the drawer of insufficiency of funds at the time of issue
elements.note: The presumption depends on notice of dishonor being received. That link is the weakest point in this file.

elements.element: Dishonor by the drawee bank for insufficiency of funds
elements.note: Return advice states the reason on its face.

elements.element: Written notice of dishonor given to the drawer
elements.note: Letter dated 10 March 2026 with a five banking day period.

elements.element: Actual receipt of the written notice by the drawer
elements.note: Neither the courier slip nor the registry return card identifies who received the letter. Obtain a legible copy before pre-trial.

elements.element: Failure to pay within five banking days from receipt of notice
elements.note: Non-payment rests on the complainant's own statement. The five day period cannot be counted until receipt is fixed.
